facts.text: A matching spec file already exists for this component at src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/__tests__/CheckoutForm.spec.tsx; a case-insensitivity fix should be covered there.

A pre-commit hook (husky) runs `npx lint-staged` and also rejects commits unless the current branch name matches ^(feature|bugfix|tech|release|hotfix)/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(/[a-z0-9-]+)?$ — the commit is rejected outright on a non-conforming branch name.
Lint is run separately via `eslint src/ migration-scripts/ next.config.source.ts postbuild.ts next-sitemap.config.ts --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx` (npm script `lint`).
